items.headline: Joint statement by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the early parliamentary elections in Serbia
items.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 28 Oct 2026 On Sunday 25 October, the people of Serbia turned out in historic numbers to make their voices heard. Voters have given the next government a strong mandate for change. We look forward to seeing this being realised in practice

items.headline: A hacker stole more than 40,000 DHS employee records
items.summary: A hacker stole a trove of personal information from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The breach exposes the names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations of more than 41,000 employees, including those in US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), according to TechCrunch and Wired.
